summary: Workflow YAML is well-structured (pinned refs, least-privilege, proper triggers). aggregator.py is high-quality with strong error handling, type hints, and docstrings. CRITICAL OMISSIONS: (1) No tests/ directory shown despite workflow running pytest tests/; (2) harness/cases.py defines test cases but no harness script uses them to run act; (3) Task requires act-result.txt artifact and iterative validation with actionlint—no evidence provided; (4) Task explicitly requires test harness that runs `act push --rm` for each case with output validation—completely missing. Code quality is solid but delivery is ~60% complete against task requirements.
